== Biography ==
Hugh Glasgow was born about 1650.

Hugh married [[Lachland-2|Margaret (Lachland) Glasgow (abt.1655-)]] on 24 May 1676 in Kilwinning, Ayrshire, Scotland.<ref>Marriage Record: HEW GLASGOW/MARGARET LACHLAND, 24 May 1676, Kilwinning, Parish 599/ M, FR34.</ref>

== Children ==
* [[Glasgow-1067|Hew Glasgow (1676-)]], baptized 5 May 1676<ref>"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950," database, FamilySearch, https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTVY-FQ2 (accessed 2025), Hew Glasgow in entry for Hew Glasgow, 1676.</ref>
* [[Glasgow-1068|Robert Glasgow (bef.1678-)]], baptized 1 December 1678 in Kilwinning<ref>Baptism Record: ROBERT, son of HEW GLASGOW, 1 Dec 1678, Kilwinning, Parish 599/ M.</ref>


== Research Notes ==
=== Selected uncertain Ayrshire family —16 October2026 ===

The 1696 Irvine father is now provisionally placed as an uncertain son through the 1676 child comparison. Select Hew [[Glasgow-1066]] and Margaret [[Lachland-2]] as the uncertain working father and mother of Hugh [[Glasgow-3109]], the Irvine father with Jean Service in 1696, through the existing strong possible identity with their 1676 Kilwinning child Hew [[Glasgow-1067]]. If baptised near birth, the child would have been about twenty in 1696. The name variant Hew/Hugh, compatible generation and neighbouring Ayrshire parish setting make this a practical preferred childhood comparison. This activates a comparison already explicitly retained in both profiles, rather than treating the 1696 child’s entry as the adult father’s birth. Maternity is assessed independently from the 1676 child clause: the supplied Scotland’s People index explicitly names Margaret Lachland with Hew Glasgow. The Findmypast transcript abbreviates/queries her name as Mt Lach?. Margaret is not selected merely because she is Hew’s spouse. Both adult parent links depend on the uncertain childhood identity and remain uncertain; the child’s recorded parentage is not proof of the adult’s origins. These are selected uncertain working relationships using existing material, not new original-record discoveries. No vital date, location, existing spouse or attached relative is cleared, and no identity merge, live WikiTree save or confidence upgrade is claimed. Counts concern retained profile accounts and inherit uncertainty and possible duplicates in older links. No original newly inspected; source dates and adult identity limits remain as assessed.</ref>

A possible identification concerns Hugh Glasgow, preacher of the gospel, indexed 1677. Hugh Glasgow was described in a 1677 printed Register of Deeds index as “preacher of the gospel.” The index lists him as grantee in a deed abbreviated “Transl.”, recorded 8 March 1677 in the Durie Office, volume 42, page 148 (National Records of Scotland RD3/42, p. 148). The underlying deed has not been examined. The identification remains uncertain.<ref>FamilySearch, ''Scotland. Land Records 1677'', item #007830797, Item 3, image 48; printed ''Register of Deeds, 1677. Name and Designation'', vol. XVII, p.80, Hugh Glasgow; Durie Office vol.42 p.148, National Records of Scotland RD3/42.
